name: apple-invites
title: Apple Invites
description: A fanned stack of event invitation cards: one upright in the middle with a photo, crown badge, avatars, title, date and place, and two tilted neighbours peeking out. It advances to the next event on a timer.
use: A landing or events page needs a lively preview of several upcoming events without a big grid.
avoid: It rotates on a timer with no pause or manual controls, and cards are fixed to a 5:8 portrait ratio.
a11y: Cards auto-rotate with no pause or manual controls, and the sequence cannot be stepped from the keyboard. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A carousel of rounded photo cards on a dark stage, one centred and two tilted behind it to left and right, each with a frosted pill badge top left, a row of round avatars, and centred white title, date and location over a blurred footer.
behaves: Every couple of seconds the cards spring sideways to the next event: the centre card slides out, a neighbour swings in to centre and a new card appears at the side. Neighbours sit rotated twelve degrees, smaller and slightly faded.
customise: Pass an events array (image or gradient, badge, title, subtitle, location, participants) plus interval, card width, height, aspect ratio and an onChange callback. Styling hooks are class props.
weight: moderate: Three stacked photo cards with five layered blur veils; springs only run on advance.
demo: Five events: Sunrise Hike, Aurora Watch, Basecamp Brunch, Maya's 30th, Summer Screening, each with a place and date.
issues: White title text over the pale Basecamp Brunch card is nearly unreadable.
polishWhy: Attractive fanned cards and a smooth spring, but white text on the pale card nearly vanishes.
